title: Hirobius Tenant Metadata
description: Identity, deployment and brand metadata for one tenant (tenants/<slug>/metadata.json). Token values live in the sibling tokens.json; this file is for tooling that needs tenant facts without parsing DTCG. Field contract: docs/architecture/tenant-token-overlay-format.md (metadata.json section). The required list and the tier 2+ legal rule follow that table. scripts/check-tenant-tokens.mjs enforces the M1 (slug matches the directory name), M2 (slug, displayName, tier, status present) and M3 (status value) subset.

slug.description: Verbatim data-tenant / data-brand attribute value. Must match the directory name (M1). A leading underscore marks a non-deployable directory such as _template.

displayName.description: UI-facing brand name, rendered in tenant-aware screens.

tagline.description: Short brand line used by previews and sales tooling.

tier.description: 1 = brand presence (marketing site), 2 = e-commerce (Stripe Checkout, legal pages), 3 = product (custom auth/dashboards). Drives infra defaults.

deployment.description: Where this tenant ships. Null until the deployment exists.

brand.description: Quick-reference brand info. The source of truth for values is tokens.json.

legal.description: Entity and jurisdiction. Fill before a tier 2+ tenant goes live; drives legal-page generation and Stripe wiring.

createdAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the tenant was scaffolded.

_notes.description: Free-form maintainer notes. Ignored by tooling.
